DRIVER BRIEFING

Feel the machine.

Build speed on the runway. Hold Space to rise, then press H to hold altitude. Momentum carries through a turn: point the car with A / D, then use rear thrust to change your path.

W / SAccelerate / brake, then reverseA / DSteer wheels / airborne yawSPACE / XLift / controlled descentSHIFTRear cold-gas thrustH / FAltitude hold / ground-effect fanQ / ERoll thrustersI / KManual pitch (stabilization off)BRear handbrakeC / OChange camera / photo modeR / ESCRecover / pause

A connected gamepad works too: left stick steers, triggers drive and brake, A lifts, B descends, X boosts, bumpers roll, D-pad up holds altitude, and Start pauses.

Finite air refills while stopped on the marked service pad. Flight trials also replenish air at checkpoints. Touch controls appear on phones and tablets.

THE REALISM REBUILD

Built to feel physical.

Four independently loaded tires, spring-and-damper suspension, combined tire grip, aerodynamic drag, a ground-effect fan, and a six-axis rigid body. Thrust consumes gas; turning in the air does not erase momentum.

The car is an original model inspired by Tesla’s October 2026 reveal. Mass, grip, suspension, aerodynamics and thruster values are simulation estimates. This is an independent fan project, not a validated model of the production vehicle.
